components.name: Quick-add Overhead Chips
components.description: Compact pill-shaped suggestions for common overhead costs, with mobile-sized touch targets.

narrative.overview: The Clear Counter is a calm, practical workspace for checking drink costs and a selling price without making the calculation feel like a finance dashboard. Keep the first screen compact and familiar: a small HPP-Ku wordmark, short Indonesian labels, clearly grouped inputs, and the HPP result easy to find.\n\nUse a clean white and blue light theme with a dark slate-blue option. Plus Jakarta Sans carries the interface; Cormorant Garamond is reserved for the HPP-Ku wordmark. Radix controls, quiet borders, and direct state messages should make each action feel familiar. The interface has no decorative imagery or oversized marketing hero. On mobile, the monthly target input uses the full row, while common overhead suggestions use compact pill chips.
keyCharacteristics: Compact calculator interface with concise Indonesian copy.
White and cool-gray surfaces, blue actions, and a user-selectable dark theme.
Ingredients and margin editor before the HPP summary on mobile.
One ingredient per table row, with optional overhead and margin controls.
Full-width monthly target input and compact common-cost chips on narrow screens.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Use blue to mark an action, selection, link, or focus state. Keep the surrounding data surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Wordmark Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep Cormorant Garamond on the HPP-Ku wordmark; use Plus Jakarta Sans for calculator content.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows to ordinary panels or controls; use surface tone and border edges to show grouping.

dos: Do keep field labels visible and copy plain, brief, and Indonesian.
Do use blue for primary actions, selection, links, and visible focus.
Do use 40px mobile field shells with 14px input text, while keeping action controls at least 44px tall.
Do put the editor before the summary on mobile and keep the selling price available in the bottom action bar.
Do keep table scrolling inside the ingredient table and preserve its pinned name column.
Do show explicit saving, saved, invalid, and error states.
Do keep quick-add overhead suggestions as compact chips with 44px mobile touch targets.
donts: Don't add a large marketing hero, decorative image, or page-entry animation.
Don't bring back the cream-and-espresso screen palette; use the documented light or dark theme.
Don't move the mobile summary ahead of ingredient and overhead entry.
Don't remove labels to make the ingredient table fit; keep its internal horizontal scroll.
Don't present invalid units or zero package quantities as a valid zero HPP.
